mapper.sql: id, material_id, material_code, material_name, warehouse, location, batch_no, qty, locked_qty, unit, supplier, production_date, expiry_date, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mat_inventory (material_id, material_code, material_name, warehouse, location, batch_no, qty, locked_qty, unit, supplier, production_date, expiry_date) VALUES (#{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{warehouse}, #{location}, #{batchNo}, #{qty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{lockedQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{unit}, #{supplier}, #{productionDate}, #{expiryDate})
mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM mat_inventory i JOIN md_material m ON i.material_id = m.id WHERE i.qty <= m.safety_stock ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
